title: 失败重建时保留最后一套一致成品
summary: 会原地替换多份已发布产物的重建流程，应在进入构建前保存最后一套一致发布状态；普通失败时整体回滚，而不是让用户看到新旧文件混杂的半成品。
invariants: The previously published coherent artifact set remains recoverable until the new build commits successfully.
Rollback scope is explicit: generated outputs/stage state may roll back while human edits, source assets and checkpoints remain outside the rollback set unless separately specified.
A process-interruption marker makes ambiguous output visibly incomplete.
Rollback failure must not be reported as successful completion.
Large artifacts may use hard links or equivalent copy-on-write mechanisms when safe, while mutable text artifacts need independent copies.
